build_environment_policy.cargo_configuration_capture: SHA-256 presence/path/symlink-target/content fingerprints for config and config.toml in CARGO_HOME and each .cargo directory from both source roots through filesystem root; verify before and after each sequential clean/build; record hashes, never config contents

protocol.cross_arm_oracle: fixture bytes/hash, frozen configuration, source/graph/harness hashes, and all full exact payload/order/metadata identity oracles must match; only scheduler-assigned global sequence numbers and absolute per-attempt paths are normalized away after within-run sequence validation
protocol.pair_order: alternating AB/BA across three warmup pairs and twelve measured pairs; first measured pair is BA

resource_metrics.claim_limit: host/workload diagnostic only; not per-thread attribution, CPU percentage, energy, sustained behavior, or capacity evidence
resource_metrics.paired_values: raw nonnegative counters and candidate-minus-baseline deltas for every measured pair; zero baseline yields no ratio

scope.process: RUSAGE_SELF process-wide counters including threads, as exposed by the host OS
scope.reaped_children: RUSAGE_CHILDREN counters for children already reaped at the post-run snapshot

resource_metrics.source: getrusage before and after the graph wall timer

protocol.retry_policy: no retries; run both sides of the current pair, then stop after any failed pair and record all remaining planned slots as not attempted
protocol.runner_base_environment: the exact controlled build environment saved in the build receipt is used and SHA-256 recorded; per-invocation values above override only the three harness variables and locale/timezone
protocol.timed_metric: one raw GraphSession wall duration per invocation; paired candidate minus baseline; positive is slower

timeout_cleanup.policy: kill the session process group; use bounded pipe-drain and reap attempts; if cleanup is unconfirmed, abort immediately and retain all unattempted slots

protocol.wall_timer: Instant immediately before GraphSession::start through return from run_to_completion; getrusage snapshots and all verification/journal/report I/O are outside it
